llm.modelsLoadError: Could not load models. Check the API key.
llm.modelUnavailable: This model is not available right now. The choice stays saved.
llm.temperatureHint: 0 to {{max}}. Low answers consistently and factually, high more varied. For code and tools 0 to 0.4 works well.
llm.maxTokensHint: A whole number from 64 to {{max}}, below the context.
llm.numCtxHint: Limits come from the selected model.
llm.numCtxUnavailable: No length limits are available for this model.
llm.numThreadHint: Default is half of the available threads.
llm.kvCacheHint: 8-bit halves the cache. Ollama 0.40 applies it only when the service starts with OLLAMA_KV_CACHE_TYPE=q8_0. The estimate follows this choice.
llm.numThreadUnavailable: CPU thread count is not available.
llm.numGpuHint: One step per layer. Default is every layer. Auto if loading fails.
llm.numGpuUnavailable: Layer count is not available for this model.
llm.vramOver: Does not fit in GPU memory. Lower context or offload, or the CPU will do the work.
llm.vramTight: Tight. A second model or a full prompt may spill.
llm.vramFormula: GPU: last {{on}} of {{total}} layers. {{full}} × {{perToken}} B/token × {{ctx}} tokens.
llm.vramFormulaMixed: GPU: last {{on}} of {{total}} layers. {{full}} global layers × {{ctx}} tokens.
llm.vramFormulaSwa: GPU: last {{on}} of {{total}} layers. {{full}} global × {{ctx}} tokens, {{swa}} sliding-window × window {{window}}.
llm.vramHint: Per-layer estimate from model data. The GPU takes the last N layers. Full attention uses the whole context. Sliding-window layers stay at their window. KV cache is f16.
llm.moeAutoHint: {{count}} experts, {{used}} active per token. All weights stay loaded. Attention stays on the GPU, and experts fill the rest.
llm.moeAutoHintNoUsed: {{count}} experts. All weights stay loaded. Attention stays on the GPU, and experts fill the rest.
llm.moeLayerWarn: This choice moves whole layers, including attention.
llm.moeUnknown: Expert weights cannot be split from this model's metadata. The meter uses the dense formula.
llm.moeRamTight: Free system RAM is below this estimate. Pinned pages and mmap can take more.
llm.moeAttention: Attention stays on the last {{on}} of {{total}} layers so it fits in GPU memory.
llm.moeSwa: With a sliding-window context, Ollama may keep every expert in system RAM even when this meter still shows free GPU space.
llm.moeEstimate: Estimate from model metadata and file size. It is recalculated for every context size.
llm.moeAutoFit: Automatic expert placement would use {{gpu}} on the GPU and leave {{ram}} in memory.

agent.hint: LLM, tools, and knowledge come from edges. Without an orchestrator, the message starts the agent.
agent.channelHint: This agent belongs to the orchestrator. Tasks arrive on the channel, and the result goes back there.
agent.maxToolCallsHint: After that the agent answers with what it has and says what is still open. Empty: 100.
agent.reasoningStepsHint: How many steps of a task give their thinking back to the model (local models). It is cut in one go: at twice as many, the older ones go at once, so the model does not read the whole transcript again at every step. Empty: 10.

orchestrator.hint: One LLM via an edge. The chat arrives here. Each agent has its own channel. Message out stays the end. It calls tools on the tool port.
orchestrator.agentMissLimitHint: How often in a row an agent may fail, or finish a task with file access without writing, editing, or deleting a file. The orchestrator then does that task. The default is 2.
orchestrator.maxAgentCallsHint: How often the orchestrator may give tasks to agents. At the limit it sums up in the chat what is done and what is still open, and the run ends. Every review round and every check counts. Empty: 50.
orchestrator.maxToolCallsHint: How many of its own tool calls the orchestrator may make for one decision after an agent call failed or during a takeover. Before that it may only read files (reads per decision). Empty: 50.
orchestrator.maxReadCallsHint: How many files the orchestrator may read in one decision while it may only read, that is until an agent call fails. If it wants to read on, it gets the next decision for it. Before the first agent call at most 10 in total apply. Empty: 15.
orchestrator.maxLlmCallsHint: Orchestrator and agents together. After that the run ends with an error. Empty: 1000.

tool.maxCallsHint: Counts every call of this tool in one run, from the orchestrator or any agent. After that it is no longer offered.
tool.credentialUrlHint: The credential is only sent to the scheme, host and port of the URL above, never to other addresses.
tool.dateHint: Shows the current time in an IANA time zone, default UTC. An instant can be shifted by days, hours, and minutes, including backwards. The gap between two instants comes back in seconds, hours, and days. Parts are the date, the clock time, and the weekday; Monday is 1. The same instant can be shown in another time zone.
tool.calculatorHint: Evaluates an expression with + - * / // % ** and parentheses. The ** exponent must be at most 20. Constants are pi and e. Functions: sqrt, cbrt, abs, round, floor, ceil, min, max, log, ln, log10, exp, sin, cos, tan, factorial. log and ln are natural logarithms; log can take a base. sin, cos, and tan use radians. factorial only accepts integers from 0 to 20.

closing.lead: Check structure, changes and risks before you confirm.

closing.running: The network is running. Stop it before applying changes.
closing.changedSince: The network was saved elsewhere since it was read in (now version {{version}}).
closing.conflictHint: Read in again discards the draft and reads the current state. Apply anyway puts the draft on top as a new version; the other state stays as the version before it.

closing.setActiveBusy: While a network runs, the active network stays as it is.

closing.versionNoteUpdate: It is saved as a new version with source “Architect”. The previous state stays as a version; “Undo last apply” brings it back.
closing.nothing: The draft matches the saved state; there is nothing to apply.
